CustomObject.description: Generic one-directional favorite/curation junction. A community user can favorite another alumnus (Alumni_Directory__c) or a business listing (Professional_Directory__c). Target_Type__c plus Target_Record_Id__c is used instead of separate lookups per target type so this object can be reused for future alumni connection features without adding more junction objects. Duplicate favorites (same Owner_Contact__c + Target_Type__c + Target_Record_Id__c) are prevented in AlumniFavoriteController Apex, not declaratively - Salesforce does not allow a unique constraint on a formula field, and a plain unique text field would require client-composed keys, which is more failure-prone than an Apex existence check before insert.
CustomObject.label: Alumni Favorite
